Bushy Brow’s Jealousy – Barrage of Lions Unleashed!. The third exam consist of one-on-one combat, and the first match is between Sasuke and Yoroi.
Kakashi and Orochimaru: Face-to-Face!. As Kakashi safely releases Sasuke from the spell, Orochimaru suddenly shows up.
Kunoichi Rumble: The Rivals Get Serious!. The preliminaries continue as the next match pits Sand Ninja Kankuro against Misumi.
The Ultimate Battle: Cha!. The next match is Sakura and Ino, childhood friends and competitors for the affection of Sasuke.
Killer Kunoichi and a Shaky Shikamaru. Tenten and Temari face off in the fifth match. The sixth match is Shikamaru versus Kin.
Akamaru Unleashed! Who’s Top Dog Now?. In the seventh match, Naruto clashes against Kiba, who brings along his dog Akamaru.
Surprise Attack! Naruto’s Secret Weapon!. Kiba and Akamaru increase their chakra levels and start their counterattack on Naruto.
Byakugan Battle: Hinata Grows Bold!. Cousins Hinata and Neji of the Hyuga clan confront each other in the eighth match.
A Failure Stands Tall!. Neji stops Hinata's flow of chakra, but Hinata finds courage by remembering Naruto's resilience.
Gaara vs. Rock Lee: The Power of Youth Explodes!. Gaara finally appears in the ninth match, and his opponent is taijutsu specialist Lee.
Lee’s Hidden Strength: Forbidden Secret Jutsu!. Lee uses the banned technique Primary Lotus to attack Gaara.
The Fifth Gate: A Splendid Ninja is Born. Lee decides to use the forbidden move, Hidden Lotus, as a last resort.
A Shadow in Darkness: Danger Approaches Sasuke. In the final match of the preliminaries, Choji fights against Orochimaru’s minion Dosu.
Ebisu Returns: Naruto’s Toughest Training Yet!. In preparation for the third exam that starts in a month, Kakashi, chooses Ebisu to train Naruto.
Long Time No See: Jiraiya Returns!. Jiraiya, one of the legendary Three Ninja, suddenly appears before Ebisu and Naruto.
The Summoning Jutsu: Wisdom of the Toad Sage!. The Sound Ninja Dosu appears before Gaara and intends on defeating Gaara.
A Feeling of Yearning, A Flower Full of Hope. Naruto continues training under Jiraiya but he has a hard time controlling the Nine-Tails' Chakra.
Live or Die: Risk it All to Win it All!. Jiraiya believes that Naruto has the makings to become a future Hokage.
He Flies! He Jumps! He Lurks! Chief Toad Appears!. Naruto is finally able to draw out the Nine-Tail Chakra and utilize the “Summoning Jutsu.”
Hospital Besieged: The Evil Hand Revealed!. On the day of the test, Gaara disappears from the inn and goes to Hidden Leaf Hospital.
The Final Rounds: Rush to the Battle Arena!. The day of the Exam finally arrives. Naruto’s first opponent is Neji Hyuga.
Byakugan vs. Shadow Clone Jutsu!. The Chunin Exam starts with the eight qualifiers, but Sasuke is nowhere to be found.
Ultimate Defense: Zero Blind Spot!. Naruto is unable to use his Shadow Clone Jutsu against Neji who can see chakra points!
A Failure’s True Power. Naruto and Neji’s battle continue with Neji showing enormous power.
Hit it or Quit it: The Final Rounds Get Complicated!. Defeated by Naruto, Neji is being taken to the hospital, when Neji’s uncle Hiashi appears.
Zero Motivation: The Guy with Cloud Envy!. Sasuke’s match is postponed and suddenly, it is Shikamaru’s turn.
Dancing Leaf, Squirming Sand. Shikamaru had the upper hand in his match with Temari, but he makes a surprising decision!
Bushy Brow’s Jutsu: Sasuke Style!. Sasuke and Gaara’a match begins.
Late for the Show, But Ready to Go! The Ultimate Secret Technique is Born!. Sauske's speed and moves are identical to Lee’s, but Gaara cannot be defeated with taijutsu.
Zero Hour! The Destuction of the Hidden Leaf Village Begins!. During the match, someone has used genjutsu to put everyone in the arena to sleep.
Village in Distress: A New A-Ranked Mission!. The Sound and Sand Ninja, along with Orochimaru, begin their move to destroy Hidden Leaf Village.
